title: 4BR Rosemary Beach Vacation Home with a Private Courtyard
meta_description: Stay at Kingston Cottage, a 4BR, 4BA Rosemary Beach vacation home with a courtyard and fountain, close to dining, shopping, and Gulf access. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- Four complimentary beach cruiser bikes included- Beach Towels Included- 7-8 Minute walk to the deeded beach in Rosemary- Mediterranean Architecture with Private Courtyard and Fountain- Inverted Floor Plan for Enhanced Privacy and Natural Light- 4 Suite Bedrooms- Multiple Outdoor Seating Areas- Two Designated Parking Spaces- Located in Rosemary Beach, Close to Dining, Shopping, and Gulf AccessWelcome to Kingston Cottage, a timeless Mediterranean-inspired retreat in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Designed with an inverted floor plan to maximize natural light and privacy, this home blends lush outdoor living with stylish interiors. The inviting courtyard, complete with a calming fountain, alfresco dining, and plush lounge seating, sets the tone for a truly relaxing coastal escape.On the first floor, two serene master suites each feature private ensuite bathrooms with double vanities—one with a walk-in shower, the other with a shower/tub combo. A laundry room with a washer and dryer is also located on this level for added convenience.The second floor serves as the home’s main gathering space, with an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area that feels both airy and inviting. The fully equipped kitchen offers island seating, while the adjacent dining table seats eight for memorable meals. Also on this floor is a comfortable queen bedroom and a full bathroom accessible from the living area.The third floor offers a cozy reading nook and a private queen suite with its own ensuite bath, creating a peaceful hideaway for guests.HOME LAYOUT (Sleeps 8)1st Floor• King Guest Bedroom with En Suite Bathroom with Walk-In Shower• King Guest Bedroom with En Suite Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo• Laundry Room with Washer/Dryer2nd Floor• Open-Concept Kitchen, Dining (seats 8), and Living area• Kitchen Island Seating (seats 3)• Queen Guest Bedroom • Full Bathroom: Hall Access with Walk-In Shower3rd Floor• Queen Guest Bedroom: En Suite Bathroom with Walk-In Shower• Reading NookOutdoor- Courtyard w/ Fountain- Outdoor Dining Area- Patio LoungersTDT-028244
